runs.name: demo_01_tree
runs.goal: Build a Python CLI called `notes` with commands `add <text>`, `list`, `search <term>`, and `delete <id>`, storing notes in a JSON file, with tests and a README.
assumptions: layout: storage.py, cli.py, tests/test_notes.py, README.md at the workspace root (flat, not a package)
notes are stored in ./notes.json as a JSON array of objects, each with 'id' (int) and 'text' (str)
ids are integers starting at 1 and incrementing; deleted ids are not reused
search is case-insensitive substring match on note text
delete of a missing id returns False and the CLI exits non-zero
add command accepts text as a single string argument (quoted if it contains spaces)
list command prints all notes sorted by id ascending
Python 3.8+ with only the standard library (argparse, json, os, sys)
storage.py and cli.py are present at the workspace root with the interfaces described
We can use unittest, tempfile, and unittest.mock.patch to temporarily replace storage.NOTES_FILE
Python 3.8+ standard library is sufficient
